evidence: regains 1 hit point at the start of each of its turns
note: Heals 4d8+15 HP now, then 1 HP per turn for an hour.

evidence: forms a new adult body for it
note: Revives a humanoid dead up to 10 days in a new body, GM-rolled race.

evidence: all curses affecting one creature or object end
note: Ends all curses on one creature or object; cursed item's curse remains.

evidence: the creature is enclosed for the duration
note: Dex save or enclosed in an immune force sphere for a minute.

evidence: add the number rolled to one saving throw of its choice
note: Touched ally adds a d4 to one saving throw, once.

evidence: The target takes a -4 penalty to all attack rolls
note: Fully restores a dead creature; -4 penalty fades each long rest.

evidence: fall upward and reach the top of the area
note: Creatures in a 100-foot cylinder fall upward for a minute, Dex save to grab.

evidence: returns to life with 1 hit point
note: Returns a creature dead under one minute to 1 hit point.

evidence: an invisible entrance opens to an extradimensional space
note: Rope leads to an extradimensional hideout for eight creatures for an hour.

evidence: must succeed on a dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 radiant damage
note: Dex save or 1d8 radiant damage, scaling with character level.

evidence: any creature who targets the warded creature with an attack
note: Attackers must Wis save or retarget; ends if ward attacks.

evidence: create one additional ray for each slot level above 2nd
note: Three fire ray spell attacks, 2d6 fire each on hit; more rays upcast.

evidence: Instead of targeting a creature, you can choose a location
note: Wis save or invisible sensor lets you see and hear the target.

evidence: hide a chest, and all its contents, on the Ethereal Plane
note: Stores a 12 cubic foot chest on the Ethereal Plane; recallable via replica.

evidence: you see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible
note: Lets caster see invisible creatures and Ethereal things for one hour.

evidence: You give each target you choose a new, illusory appearance
note: Cha save for unwilling targets to change appearance; lasts eight hours.

evidence: send a short message of twenty-five words or less
note: Sends a 25-word telepathic message to a familiar creature, which can reply.

evidence: it falls into a state of suspended animation
note: Hides a willing creature or object in stasis until dispelled or triggered.

evidence: Your game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the chosen creature
note: Transform into a creature of CR up to your level, using its stats.

evidence: has disadvantage on this saving throw
note: Con save for 3d8 thunder in 10-foot sphere, half on success.

evidence: you have a +5 bonus to AC
note: Reaction +5 AC until next turn, immune to magic missile.

evidence: granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration
note: Bonus action grants a creature +2 AC while concentrated, up to 10 minutes.

evidence: you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength
note: Bonus action makes a club or staff use spellcasting ability and d8 damage.

evidence: it can't take reactions until the start of its next turn
note: Melee spell attack, 1d8 lightning; target loses reactions until its next turn.

evidence: creatures are deafened while entirely inside it
note: Silences a 20-foot sphere; creatures inside are deafened, no verbal spells.

evidence: The image is purely visual; it isn't accompanied by sound
note: Creates a 15-foot-cube visual illusion you can move; Int check reveals it.

evidence: You shape an illusory duplicate of one beast or humanoid
note: Creates a half-HP duplicate of a beast or humanoid over 12 hours.

evidence: falls unconscious until the spell ends
note: Knocks creatures unconscious by total HP pool, 1 minute, no save.

evidence: On a failed save, it falls prone.
note: Icy 40-foot cylinder: Dex save or fall prone, difficult terrain, obscures.

evidence: makes another wisdom saving throw at the end of its turn
note: Up to six creatures: Wis save, halved speed, -2 AC, one attack, repeat save.

evidence: The creature becomes stable.
note: Touch a 0 HP living creature to stabilize it; no effect on undead.

evidence: You gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts
note: Lets caster talk with beasts for ten minutes; favors at GM's discretion.

evidence: you can ask the corpse up to five questions
note: Corpse answers up to five questions for ten minutes; cannot be undead.

evidence: turn ordinary terrain where plants are present into difficult terrain
note: Talk to plants for info; can toggle terrain to difficult for ten minutes.

evidence: gains a climbing speed equal to its walking speed
note: Touched ally climbs walls and ceilings at walking speed for an hour, concentration.

evidence: it takes 2d4 piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels
note: Difficult spiky terrain; 2d4 piercing per 5 feet moved, for ten minutes.

evidence: its speed is halved in the area
note: Aura 15 ft around you: halved speed; Wis save or 3d8 radiant/necrotic.

evidence: create a floating, spectral weapon within range
note: Floating force weapon attacks for 1d8+mod on cast and each bonus action, one minute.

evidence: must make a constitution saving throw against poison
note: Con save each turn in 20-foot sphere; failure wastes the creature's action.

evidence: form it into any shape that suits your purpose
note: Reshapes a stone object or 5-foot section into any desired shape.
